notes.title: A new version 2.5.94 has been released
notes.content:
New:

- Fixed bug with call to coop bosses mode Armageddon

notes.title: New version released 2.5.90
notes.content:
New:
- A brand new levels system. Now the levels cap is 99. Health at all levels is the same. The number of skill points at all levels is 60. The level requirements for buying and upgrading weapons is removed. Changed the mercenaries price 
- Optimized effects performance
- Fixed an issue with ability to destroy a gas cloud with a sledgehammer
- The gas cloud now rises with the water level
- Hints of characters in battle are caused by clicking on the character
- Slightly reduced the sound volume of cat ammo
- Removed the ability to downgrade an weapon in a friend's craft room

notes.title: A new version 2.5.77 has been released
notes.content:
New:
- A new wepon system. Now you can buy weapons by shots
- Fixed errors in calculating achievements
- Fixed bank purchase issues
- Removed auto-defeats with multiple cancellations of weapons shot
- Improved reconnection during missions, lost loss rewards
- Improved control with the joystick in battle
- Fixed issue with hotkeys
- Added previous tab saving into arena menu

notes.title: A new version 2.5.63 has been released

- Disabled weapon hot keys while writing a message to battle chat
- Fixed friends loading bugs

notes.title: A new version 2.5.57 has been released
notes.content:
A new version 2.5.57 has been released
New:
- The mechanics of the teleport have been changed. Now the usual teleport and medical teleport teleport only to the free areas of the map, where the character can fit. Teleport mk2 teleports to free areas of the map, where there is at least one free pixel
- Due to the fact that the teleport was changed, we will take the teleport from all the players and give out compensation in rubies. Teleport can be bought again
- Added the ability to change the order of the characters in the team
- In-game character ID is moved to character hints
- The selected cells are highlighted in the store and in the bank
- Added hints for the dropped caps in battle
- Added advanced hints for the character equip in combat. Hold shift to check character equip
- Improved protection against cheats. Now the server can give the ban for cheating in battle.
- Fixed bug when creating a map
- Fixed bugs that appear during the playback of the particle animation
- Fixed other minor bugs
